name: Toast
looksLike: small message that pops up in the corner and disappears
little black bar at the bottom saying saved
notification that fades away by itself
definition: A brief message that appears over the page, usually in a corner, and dismisses itself after a few seconds. It never blocks the page.
whenToUse: Confirming a save or a copy

notConfusedWith.difference: Blocks the page and needs a response.
Anchored to a trigger instead of a screen corner.

prompts.short: Show a toast bottom-right after save. Auto-dismiss in 3s.
prompts.detailed: Add a toast system: bottom-right stack, auto-dismiss after 3s, pause on hover, with success and error variants and an optional Undo action. Render it in a polite live region so screen readers announce it.

reactTailwind: className="fixed bottom-4 right-4 rounded-lg bg-gray-900 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-white shadow-lg"

a11yNotes: Don't auto-dismiss messages people need time to read
Pause the timer on hover and focus
